import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Pair<A, B> {
        public A first;
        public B second;
        public Pair(A first, B second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Tuple3<A, B, C> {
        public A first;
        public B second;
        public C third;
        public Tuple3(A first, B second, C third) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
            this.third = third;
        }
    }

    static String toString(String s) {
        return "\"" + s + "\"";
    }

    static String toString(char[] s) {
        return toString(new String(s));
    }

    static String toString(boolean b) {
        return b ? "true" : "false";
    }

    static String toString(List<Boolean> v) {
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder("{");
        boolean first = true;
        for (Boolean b : v) {
            if (!first) res.append(", ");
            first = false;
            res.append(toString(b));
        }
        res.append("}");
        return res.toString();
    }

    static String toString(BitSet v, int N) {
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            res.append(v.get(i) ? '1' : '0');
        }
        return res.toString();
    }

    static <A> String toString(List<A> v) {
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder("{");
        boolean first = true;
        for (A x : v) {
            if (!first) res.append(", ");
            first = false;
            res.append(toString(x));
        }
        res.append("}");
        return res.toString();
    }

    static String toString(Pair<?, ?> p) {
        return "(" + toString(p.first) + ", " + toString(p.second) + ")";
    }

    static String toString(Tuple3<?, ?, ?> p) {
        return "(" + toString(p.first) + ", " + toString(p.second) + ", " + toString(p.third) + ")";
    }

    static void debug_out() {
        System.err.println();
    }

    static <Head, Tail> void debug_out(Head H, Tail... T) {
        System.err.print(" " + toString(H));
        debug_out(T);
    }

    static <T> T inverse(T a, T m) {
        if (a instanceof Integer && m instanceof Integer) {
            int aa = (Integer) a;
            int mm = (Integer) m;
            int u = 0, v = 1;
            while (aa != 0) {
                int t = mm / aa;
                int temp = aa;
                aa = mm % aa;
                mm = temp;
                int tempU = u;
                u = v - t * u;
                v = tempU - t * v;
            }
            if (mm != 1) throw new ArithmeticException("Inverse does not exist");
            return (T) Integer.valueOf(u);
        }
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Inverse not implemented for type");
    }

    static class Modular<T> {
        T value;
        static int mod;

        Modular() {
            this.value = null;
        }

        <U> Modular(U x) {
            this.value = normalize(x);
        }

        static <U> int normalize(U x) {
            if (x instanceof Integer) {
                int v = (Integer) x;
                v %= mod;
                if (v < 0) v += mod;
                return v;
            }
            throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Normalization not implemented for type");
        }

        int get() {
            return (Integer) value;
        }

        Modular<T> add(Modular<T> other) {
            int res = get() + other.get();
            if (res >= mod) res -= mod;
            this.value = (T) Integer.valueOf(res);
            return this;
        }

        Modular<T> subtract(Modular<T> other) {
            int res = get() - other.get();
            if (res < 0) res += mod;
            this.value = (T) Integer.valueOf(res);
            return this;
        }

        Modular<T> multiply(Modular<T> other) {
            long res = (long) get() * other.get();
            res %= mod;
            this.value = (T) Integer.valueOf((int) res);
            return this;
        }

        Modular<T> divide(Modular<T> other) {
            return multiply(new Modular<T>(inverse(other.get(), mod)));
        }

        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(get());
        }
    }

    static int n, m;
    static int md;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        md = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        Modular.mod = md;

        List<Modular<Integer>> fact = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Modular<Integer>> inv_fact = new ArrayList<>();
        fact.add(new Modular<>(1));
        inv_fact.add(new Modular<>(1));

        // Function for combination
        java.util.function.BiFunction<Integer, Integer, Modular<Integer>> C = (x, y) -> {
            int sz = Math.max(x, y);
            while (fact.size() <= sz) {
                int size = fact.size();
                fact.add(fact.get(size - 1).multiply(new Modular<>(size)));
                inv_fact.add(new Modular<>(inverse(fact.get(size).get(), md)));
            }
            if (y < 0 || y > x) return new Modular<>(0);
            return fact.get(x).multiply(inv_fact.get(y)).multiply(inv_fact.get(x - y));
        };

        List<Modular<Integer>> ptr_ways = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m + 1, new Modular<>(0)));
        List<Modular<Integer>> ptr_dp = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m + 1, new Modular<>(0)));
        ptr_ways.set(0, new Modular<>(1));

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            Modular<Integer> sumWays = new Modular<>(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular<Integer> term = ptr_ways.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r)).multiply(C.apply(l + r, l)).multiply(new Modular<>(l + r + 2));
                sumWays.add(term);
            }
            ptr_ways.set(i, sumWays);
        }

        List<Modular<Integer>> ptr_dp_temp = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(m + 1, new Modular<>(0)));
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            Modular<Integer> sumDp = new Modular<>(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int l = j;
                int r = i - 1 - l;
                Modular<Integer> add = new Modular<>((l * (l + 1) + r * (r + 1)) / 2);
                Modular<Integer> term1 = ptr_ways.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r)).multiply(C.apply(l + r, l)).multiply(add);
                Modular<Integer> term2 = (ptr_dp.get(l).multiply(ptr_ways.get(r)).add(ptr_dp.get(r).multiply(ptr_ways.get(l)))).multiply(C.apply(l + r, r)).multiply(new Modular<>(l + r + 2));
                sumDp.add(term1).add(term2);
            }
            ptr_dp.set(i, sumDp);
        }

        Modular<Integer>[][] dp = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];
        Modular<Integer>[][] ways = new Modular[n + 1][m + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = new Modular<>(0);
                ways[i][j] = new Modular<>(0);
            }
        }
        ways[0][0] = new Modular<>(1);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s <= Math.min(m, i); s++) {
                if (s == i) {
                    dp[i][s] = ptr_dp.get(s);
                    ways[i][s] = ptr_ways.get(s);
                    continue;
                }
                for (int d = 1; d <= s + 1; d++) {
                    if (i - d >= 0 && s + 1 - d >= 0) {
                        Modular<Integer> ft = dp[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                        Modular<Integer> way = ways[i - d][s + 1 - d];
                        int add = d - 1;
                        ways[i][s] = ways[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptr_ways.get(add)).multiply(C.apply(s, add)));
                        dp[i][s] = dp[i][s].add(way.multiply(ptr_dp.get(add)).add(ptr_ways.get(add).multiply(ft)).multiply(C.apply(s, add)));
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[n][m]);
    }
}
